roadmap.title: Training and Contracts
roadmap.description: Learn the controls in the Prologue, then finish the Contract tutorial, leaderboard task and an ICA Facility Escalation. Stay online for Contracts and progression.

roadmap.title: HITMAN campaign and mastery
roadmap.description: Play Paris through Hokkaido. Complete new challenges on each map to reach mastery 20, and finish a bonus mission with Suit Only and Silent Assassin. Casual difficulty allows manual saves.

roadmap.title: HITMAN 2 campaign and expansion
roadmap.description: Play Hawke's Bay through Isle of Sgàil, then New York and Haven Island with the HITMAN 2 Expansion Access Pass. Finish each location's mastery challenges. Hawke's Bay needs mastery 5; the other locations need mastery 20.

roadmap.title: HITMAN 3 campaign and challenges
roadmap.description: Play Dubai through the Carpathian Mountains. Complete each map's hidden kills, discovery and story tasks while building mastery. Open shortcuts as you go. Save before alternate kills, reload for the next method, then finish the mission to apply challenge XP. Missions remain replayable.

roadmap.title: Sniper Assassin cleanup
roadmap.description: Play Himmelstein, then Hantu Port and Siberia. Complete the latter maps' challenges to build score multipliers before the million-point attempts. Hantu Port and Siberia require the HITMAN 2 Expansion Access Pass.

achievements.description: Complete Freeform Training in the Prologue.
achievements.summary: Finish the Freeform Training mission in the Prologue.

steps.text: Open Campaigns, then Prologue, and finish @mechanic{Freeform Training}.

achievements.description: Complete The Final Test in the Prologue.
achievements.summary: Finish The Final Test mission in the Prologue.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{The Final Test} in the Prologue and leave through its exit after eliminating Jasper Knight.

achievements.description: Complete any Mission Story in The Final Test.
achievements.summary: Finish one Mission Story during The Final Test.

steps.text: In The Final Test, open the Mission Stories tab and track @mechanic{Safety First}. Complete its marked objectives.

achievements.summary: Finish the tutorial for creating Contracts.

steps.text: Choose Game Modes → Contracts → Create Contract → Tutorial and finish the tutorial.

achievements.description: Complete The Final Test unspotted. Kill only Jasper Knight, ensuring his body is not found.
achievements.summary: Finish The Final Test without being spotted, killing anyone except Jasper Knight, or letting his body be found.

guide.context: Make a manual save before entering the building. Reload that save if you are spotted or a body is found.

steps.text: Approach the building from the left. Wait for the mechanics to leave the pipe, then climb the pipe and enter the upstairs window.
Drop your pistol by the door so Knight's guard takes the weapon away. Kill Knight while he is alone and put his body in the bathroom container.
Return down the pipe. Distract the guard below with a coin if needed, then reach the exit unseen.

achievements.description: Complete Level 5 of an Escalation Contract set in the ICA Facility.
achievements.summary: Finish the fifth level of an ICA Facility Escalation Contract.

steps.text: At the ICA Facility, select @mechanic{The Einarsson Inception}. Finish its five levels, following the targets, disguises and restrictions shown for each level.

achievements.description: Beat the highest leaderboard score on a Contract.
achievements.summary: Finish a Contract with a score higher than its existing leaderboard record.

steps.text: Create and publish a simple Contract with one nearby target.
Play that Contract once slowly to record a low score. Replay the Contract and finish faster with fewer penalties to take first place.

achievements.summary: Finish one Featured Contract.

steps.text: Open Game Modes → Contracts → Featured Contracts. Select an available Contract and complete its required objectives.

achievements.description: Assassinate Targets with Ballistic, Accident and Explosion Kills.
achievements.summary: Kill mission targets using a firearm, an accident and an explosion.

steps.text: Across your missions, kill a target with a gun, another through an accident, and another with an explosion. These kills can come from separate missions.

achievements.description: Assassinate a Target without getting spotted.
achievements.summary: Kill a mission target without being seen during the assassination.

steps.text: Kill a target while nobody can see you, such as by attacking an isolated target from behind.

achievements.summary: Open 15 distinct shortcuts.

guide.context: Opened shortcuts stay available on later visits; any 15 of the 17 count.

collectibles.method: Lower the ladder with a crowbar.

collectibles.name: Biker Basement Door
collectibles.method: Open the door leading toward the basement.

collectibles.name: Skylight Ladder

collectibles.name: Facility Elevator Shaft

collectibles.name: Inner Courtyard
collectibles.method: Reach the far side and open the shortcut door.

collectibles.name: The Block Ladder
collectibles.location: Level 2, in a corner of Hush's building balcony.
collectibles.method: Lower the ladder with a crowbar.

collectibles.name: Cellar Door
collectibles.location: Level 3, reached from the villa basement.
collectibles.method: Open the cellar shortcut from the basement side.

collectibles.name: Backdoor
collectibles.location: Level 2, along the curved path below the mansion.
collectibles.method: Follow the path down and open the shortcut door.

collectibles.name: Maintenance Door
collectibles.location: Level 3, reached from the villa basement.
collectibles.method: Open the maintenance shortcut from the basement side.

collectibles.name: Passenger Car Door
collectibles.location: The carriage after the weapon workbench.
collectibles.method: Go to the next usable window, climb outside and move back to enter the blocked compartment through its window. Open the door inside.

collectibles.name: Container Door
collectibles.location: A later container blocking the train route.
collectibles.method: Take the valve from the next carriage, fit the valve on the container's far side and turn the valve to open the door.

achievements.summary: Receive ten different playstyle ratings after completing missions.

steps.text: Finish missions with different approaches, including silent kills, accidents, firearms and open combat. Check the playstyle name on each results screen and keep earning new names until you have ten.

achievements.description: Complete On Top Of The World.
achievements.summary: Finish On Top of the World in Dubai.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{On Top of the World} in @loc{Dubai}, complete the displayed mission objectives and use an exit.

achievements.description: Reveal all undiscovered areas in Dubai.
achievements.summary: Uncover every map area in Dubai.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Dubai} map and visit each question-mark area on every floor. Enter the area until its name appears, then finish the mission after clearing the remaining markers.

achievements.description: Kill Ingram on his oil-rig model, throw Stuyvesant off a railing, and kill both targets during their parachute escape.
achievements.summary: Kill Ingram on his oil-rig model, throw Stuyvesant off a railing, and kill both targets during their parachute escape.

guide.context: The three kill conditions can be completed across replays. Save before committing to a kill so you can reload for another method.

steps.text: Track @mechanic{Bird of Prey}. At the final meeting, stand behind Ingram at his desk and use the oil-rig model to kill him.
On another run or reload, finish @mechanic{(In)Security}. Push Stuyvesant off the ledge after he dismisses his guard.
For the parachute kills, take the evacuation card from the Level 3 Security Room safe using @mechanic{6927}. Swipe the evacuation readers on Levels 4 and 5 in quick succession.
Follow the escaping targets to their jump point. Shoot both parachutes after the targets jump, then finish the mission.

achievements.description: Make a target wearing a skydiving suit slip on a banana peel during the Dubai evacuation.
achievements.summary: Make a target wearing a skydiving suit slip on a banana peel during the Dubai evacuation.

steps.text: Get a banana and the evacuation card in the Level 3 Security Room. The safe code is @mechanic{6927}.
Place the banana as a peel trap at the edge of the Level 4 outdoor jump point by the golfing equipment. Place the trap rather than throwing the banana.
Swipe the Level 4 and Level 5 evacuation readers quickly, then wait for a target in a skydiving suit to step on the peel. Keep the trap at the jump edge so a guard does not use it first.

achievements.description: Complete all Mission Stories in On Top Of The World.
achievements.summary: Finish every Mission Story in On Top of the World.

steps.text: In Dubai, track @mechanic{(In)Security} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.
In Dubai, track @mechanic{Bird of Prey} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.
In Dubai, track @mechanic{How the Mighty Fall} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.

achievements.summary: Raise Dubai location mastery to level 20.

steps.text: While connected online, complete unfinished challenges in @loc{Dubai} for mastery XP. Use the Challenges tab to choose new tasks, then finish a mission to apply the XP.

achievements.summary: Finish Death in the Family in Dartmoor.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Death in the Family} in @loc{Dartmoor}, complete the displayed mission objectives and use an exit.

achievements.description: Reveal all undiscovered areas in Dartmoor.
achievements.summary: Uncover every map area in Dartmoor.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Dartmoor} map and visit each question-mark area on every floor. Enter the area until its name appears, then finish the mission after clearing the remaining markers.

achievements.description: Kill Alexa in her private room, snipe her from the roof, and bury her in her grave.
achievements.summary: Kill Alexa in her private room, snipe her from the roof, and bury her in her grave.

guide.context: Save before killing Alexa; each method can be completed after a reload or on a separate visit.

steps.text: Get a bodyguard disguise and enter Alexa's private room off her Level 2 office. Kill her there, or bring her unconscious body into the room before killing her.

For the roof kill, bring a sniper rifle. Shoot the three crow nests at the graveyard without alarming the undertaker, then climb onto the roof through the window beside the upper office stairs. Snipe Alexa when she meets the undertaker.
On another run or reload, finish @mechanic{Her Final Resting Place}. Push Alexa into the open grave when she examines it and use the shovel to cover her.

achievements.description: Cause Emma to poison and kill Alexa Carlisle.
achievements.summary: Cause Emma to poison and kill Alexa Carlisle.

steps.text: Follow @mechanic{Means, Motive and Opportunity} as the detective. Gather the clues in the greenhouse and enough evidence in the butler's office to accuse Mr. Fernsby.
Use a wrench to repair the greenhouse distillation equipment before giving Alexa your conclusion.
Accuse @npc{Mr. Fernsby} and choose the money reward. Let Alexa speak to the family, then wait for Emma to make poison in the repaired greenhouse and put the poison in Alexa's drink.

achievements.description: Complete all Mission Stories in Death In The Family.
achievements.summary: Finish every Mission Story in Death in the Family.

steps.text: In Dartmoor, track @mechanic{Means, Motive and Opportunity} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.
In Dartmoor, track @mechanic{Her Final Resting Place} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.
In Dartmoor, track @mechanic{A Day to Remember} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.

achievements.summary: Raise Dartmoor location mastery to level 20.

steps.text: While connected online, complete unfinished challenges in @loc{Dartmoor} for mastery XP. Use the Challenges tab to choose new tasks, then finish a mission to apply the XP.

achievements.summary: Finish Apex Predator in Berlin.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Apex Predator}, identify and kill five ICA agents, then escape Berlin. Use Instinct to watch for agents who can see through your disguise.

achievements.description: Reveal all undiscovered areas in Berlin.
achievements.summary: Uncover every map area in Berlin.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Berlin} map and visit each question-mark area on every floor. Enter the area until its name appears, then finish the mission after clearing the remaining markers.

achievements.description: Kill Tremaine with his rifle, crush Thames with the crane, and electrocute Montgomery and Banner together with the light rig.
achievements.summary: Kill Tremaine with his rifle, crush Thames with the crane, and electrocute Montgomery and Banner together with the light rig.

guide.context: Save before each setup or replay Berlin to complete the other kills. Killing five agents makes the survivors evacuate.

steps.text: In the Level 2 biker clubhouse, take Agent Tremaine's mounted sniper rifle and shoot Tremaine with it.

At the Level 0 Back Entrance, get the fuse from the yellow dumpster between the Back Entrance and Biker Hangout. Fit the fuse in the crane console, climb the crane and release the load when Thames stands in the lit impact area.
On a separate run or reload, sabotage the Level -1 Light Tree Installation with a screwdriver. Take the spare DJ's disguise on Level -2 and dismiss the DJ at the booth.
Wait until Montgomery joins Banner on the walkway above the dance floor, then overload the lighting to kill both agents.

achievements.description: Photograph all seven yellow bird graffiti in Berlin and finish Apex Predator.
achievements.summary: Photograph all seven yellow bird graffiti in Berlin and finish Apex Predator.

guide.context: Wait for the Concrete Ornithology counter after each photograph. Complete Apex Predator after taking all seven photos.

collectibles.name: Sunglasses bird
collectibles.location: Level 0, on the west exterior wall of the club, between the two long rectangular structures.
collectibles.method: Photograph the round yellow bird wearing sunglasses.

collectibles.name: Bird above the yellow bin

collectibles.method: Photograph the bird partly covered by the yellow rubbish bin.

collectibles.name: Bird beside the container

collectibles.method: Photograph the smaller bird higher on the wall beside the shipping container.

collectibles.method: Photograph the mural of four yellow birds stacked vertically.

collectibles.name: Bird by the stairs

collectibles.method: Aim the camera at the single yellow bird on the pillar.

collectibles.name: Bird beside the roof door

collectibles.method: Photograph the large bird beside the doorway.

collectibles.name: Birds behind the roof door

collectibles.method: Move around the door and photograph the group of birds above the opening.

achievements.description: Become the club owner, and have a sit down with the ICA.
achievements.summary: Sit down with the ICA agents as club owner Rolf Hirschmüller and escape Berlin afterward.

steps.text: Reach Hirschmüller's office on Level -2 without knocking out or killing the other guards. Turn on the record player to lure Hirschmüller behind the corner, subdue him and hide his body.
Take Hirschmüller's disguise and dropped phonebook. Use the office phone, then sit at the desk when the ICA agents arrive.
After the meeting begins, kill the five ICA agents and escape. If nobody answers the phone, replay the mission and leave the other guards alone before calling.

achievements.summary: Raise Berlin location mastery to level 20.

steps.text: While connected online, complete unfinished challenges in @loc{Berlin} for mastery XP. Use the Challenges tab to choose new tasks, then finish a mission to apply the XP.

achievements.summary: Finish End of an Era in Chongqing.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{End of an Era} in @loc{Chongqing}, complete the displayed mission objectives and use an exit.

achievements.description: Reveal all undiscovered areas in Chongqing.
achievements.summary: Uncover every map area in Chongqing.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Chongqing} map and visit each question-mark area on every floor. Enter the area until its name appears, then finish the mission after clearing the remaining markers.

achievements.description: Kill Hush in his relaxation chair, electrocute Royce, and kill both targets with one bullet.
achievements.summary: Kill Hush in his relaxation chair, electrocute Royce, and kill both targets with one bullet.

guide.context: Save before killing a target, or use separate mission replays for the three methods.

steps.text: In Hush's building, take the fuse on Level 3 to the Level 5 Therapy Room; use @mechanic{2552} for the door. Repair the chair and kill Hush when he sits down.
On another run or reload, knock out Royce and drag her to the Level -2 facility Break Room. Place her beside the water cooler and socket, then shoot the cooler and socket to electrocute her.
For the shared bullet, bring a piercing sniper rifle and finish @mechanic{All-Seeing Eyes}. At the Lotus Passage meeting, line up Hush and Royce and shoot through both with one bullet.

achievements.description: Trigger a core cleansing through Royce's terminal while the safety system is disabled.
achievements.summary: Trigger a core cleansing through Royce's terminal while the safety system is disabled.

steps.text: Follow @mechanic{Certainty Principle} until Royce demonstrates her employee terminal.
Fire @npc{Jeremy Bolt} so he leaves his post, then fire @npc{Alicia Reynolds}. Watch the core camera until Alicia disables its safety system.
Wait until Royce enters the core, then fire @npc{Sharon Reed}. Sharon starts the cleansing cycle and the disabled safety system allows the core to burn.

achievements.description: Complete all Mission Stories in End Of An Era.
achievements.summary: Finish every Mission Story in End of an Era.

steps.text: In Chongqing, track @mechanic{Certainty Principle} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.
In Chongqing, track @mechanic{Impulse Control} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.
In Chongqing, track @mechanic{All-Seeing Eyes} from the Mission Stories tab and finish its marked objectives.

achievements.summary: Raise Chongqing location mastery to level 20.

steps.text: While connected online, complete unfinished challenges in @loc{Chongqing} for mastery XP. Use the Challenges tab to choose new tasks, then finish a mission to apply the XP.

achievements.summary: Finish The Farewell in Mendoza.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{The Farewell} in @loc{Mendoza}, complete the displayed mission objectives and use an exit.

achievements.description: Reveal all undiscovered areas in Mendoza.
achievements.summary: Uncover every map area in Mendoza.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Mendoza} map and visit each question-mark area on every floor. Enter the area until its name appears, then finish the mission after clearing the remaining markers.

achievements.description: Kill Vidal in the grape crusher, kill Yates with poisoned Grand Paladin, and kill both targets with gas.
achievements.summary: Kill Vidal in the grape crusher, kill Yates with poisoned Grand Paladin, and kill both targets with gas.

guide.context: Make a manual save before each kill setup. The gas can kill Diana and fail the mission. A progression bug can also leave this achievement locked after the three kill challenges are complete.

steps.text: During @mechanic{The Tour}, present the grape crusher in the Fermentation Room to Vidal. When Vidal leans over the crusher, push her in.

On another run or reload, put lethal poison in Yates's glass at the head of the meeting table in the Level 3 Villa Basement. Follow @mechanic{Closing Statement} as the Sommelier and serve the 1945 Grand Paladin. Wait for Yates to drink.
For the gas kill, bring lethal poison or take the poison from the Level 5 Villa Bathroom. Clear the two workers from the Level 1 Tech Room and learn the route to the Level 2 Security Room.

Finish The Tour and wait until Vidal and Yates are together in the Barrel Room. Throw an object to distract Vidal so she stays there. Add lethal poison to the Tech Room ventilation and turn the system on, then use the Security Room console to send the gas into the Barrel Room before either target leaves.

achievements.description: Attend the secret Providence meeting in Mendoza.
achievements.summary: Attend the secret Providence meeting in Mendoza.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{The Tour}, then follow @mechanic{Closing Statement}. Disguise yourself as the Sommelier and bring the 1945 Grand Paladin to the meeting. Finish the meeting sequence and change into Agent 47's suit.

achievements.description: Complete all Mission Stories in The Farewell.
achievements.summary: Finish every Mission Story in The Farewell.

steps.text: In Mendoza, track and finish @mechanic{The Tour}, @mechanic{Eyes on Target} and @mechanic{Over the Top}.
After The Tour, stay near the barrel room to reveal @mechanic{Closing Statement}. Follow the Sommelier objectives, deliver the 1945 Grand Paladin and finish the meeting sequence.

achievements.summary: Raise Mendoza location mastery to level 20.

steps.text: While connected online, complete unfinished challenges in @loc{Mendoza} for mastery XP. Use the Challenges tab to choose new tasks, then finish a mission to apply the XP.

achievements.summary: Finish Untouchable in Carpathian Mountains.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Untouchable} in @loc{Carpathian Mountains}, complete the displayed mission objectives and use an exit.

achievements.description: Kill a guard with a silenced pistol, a guard with a shotgun and a guard with an SMG during Untouchable.
achievements.summary: Kill a guard with a silenced pistol, a guard with a shotgun and a guard with an SMG during Untouchable.

steps.text: At the workbench about halfway along the train, make a silenced pistol and use the pistol to kill a guard.
Take a shotgun and an SMG from the passenger shortcut compartment or the armed guards farther along the train. Kill a guard with each weapon.

achievements.description: Use the memory serum on Agent 47 at the end of Untouchable.
achievements.summary: Use the memory serum on Agent 47 at the end of Untouchable.

steps.text: Make a manual save before confronting Arthur Edwards. Pick up the serum and wait about one minute without injecting Edwards. After his new dialogue, choose the option to inject yourself. Reload the save to pursue the other ending.

achievements.summary: Complete the Untouchable mission challenges, including the Codename 47 challenge chain.

guide.context: Complete the Codename 47 group in the listed order. Make a manual save before confronting Edwards so you can reload for the other serum outcome. Finish the mission to apply challenge progress; an unlock bug can persist even after the full challenge set is complete.

collectibles.name: Losing Everything

collectibles.location: Near the end of the guard carriages.
collectibles.method: Take the Commando Leader disguise from the officer another guard salutes.

collectibles.name: Heavy Duty
collectibles.location: The outdoor guard sections near the end.

collectibles.name: 47, Ph.D.

collectibles.name: Mall Cop

collectibles.method: Take the uniform of a Security Guard wearing a baseball cap.

collectibles.name: Spray and Slay
collectibles.method: Pick up the SMG.

collectibles.name: Chameleon
collectibles.method: Wear all seven outfits: Providence Doctor, Security Guard, Elite Guard, Commando Guard, Commando Leader, Office Staff and Providence Security Guard. Office Staff clothing hangs on a rack just beyond the commandos; the final security outfit comes from the black-suited guards without caps in the office carriages.

collectibles.name: You've Got Some Skills
collectibles.method: Wear the Elite Guard outfit from a guard with a black helmet.

collectibles.name: Forbidden Pineapple
collectibles.location: The weapons carriage with two Elite Guards.
collectibles.method: Collect a fragmentation grenade from a weapon table.

collectibles.name: Got My Boomstick
collectibles.method: Pick up the shotgun.

collectibles.name: Container Door
collectibles.location: The later container blocking the route.
collectibles.method: Fetch the valve in the following carriage and use the valve to open the container.

collectibles.name: Snow Angel
collectibles.location: An outdoor carriage with a guard near the edge.
collectibles.method: Push a guard off the train.

collectibles.name: The Gun Muffler
collectibles.location: The weapon workbench halfway along the train.
collectibles.method: Craft a suppressed pistol at the bench.

collectibles.name: Exhibition Shooting

collectibles.name: Soda Slinger
collectibles.method: Pick up three soda cans and knock out three guards by throwing a can at each guard.

collectibles.name: A New Father
collectibles.method: Pick up the serum, wait about a minute for Edwards's extra dialogue and inject yourself.

collectibles.name: Eliminate The Constant
collectibles.method: Kill Arthur Edwards.

collectibles.name: Suit Only
collectibles.method: Finish Untouchable without changing from your starting outfit.

collectibles.name: Silent Assassin
collectibles.method: Finish without being spotted or allowing bodies to be discovered. Kill only the target.

collectibles.name: Silent Assassin, Suit Only
collectibles.method: Combine the Silent Assassin restrictions with wearing only the starting outfit.

collectibles.name: The Red Dragon
collectibles.location: Chongqing, at the neon-sign vantage point.
collectibles.method: Bring a sniper rifle to the neon sign used in @mechanic{All-Seeing Eyes}. Headshot a mission target from that vantage point.

collectibles.name: Say Hello to My Little Friend
collectibles.location: Santa Fortuna, in the village and at the Shaman Hut.
collectibles.method: First complete The Red Dragon. Subdue the shopkeeper outside the orange shop with the green door beside the village riverfront path. Take his shop key and unlock the door with that key; other opening methods do not spawn the Gold Idol. Pick up the @item{Gold Idol} inside, then use the idol to knock out the Shaman at the Shaman Hut.

collectibles.name: Traditions of the Trade
collectibles.method: After Say Hello to My Little Friend, drown a mission target in Bangkok.

collectibles.name: Explosions Run Loose
collectibles.method: After Traditions of the Trade, kill five ICA agents using explosives during a single Berlin mission attempt.

collectibles.name: The Setup
collectibles.method: After Explosions Run Loose, kill every guard on the train. At Edwards, pick up the serum and wait for the self-injection dialogue, then inject yourself.

achievements.summary: Raise Carpathian Mountains location mastery to level 5.

steps.text: While connected online, complete unfinished challenges in @loc{Carpathian Mountains} for mastery XP. Use the Challenges tab to choose new tasks, then finish a mission to apply the XP.

achievements.description: Get a score above 1,000,000 points on The Pen and the Sword.
achievements.summary: Finish The Pen and the Sword with more than 1,000,000 points.

steps.text: Complete Hantu Port challenges to raise the permanent score multiplier. With the multiplier near its maximum of 3.0, finish a Silent Assassin run by hiding target bodies and avoiding civilian casualties or an alarm.

achievements.description: Complete The Pen and the Sword as Silent Assassin.
achievements.summary: Earn Silent Assassin on The Pen and the Sword.

guide.context: If the alarm starts or a civilian dies, restart the sniper mission and try again.

steps.text: In Hantu Port, kill the marked targets without hurting the hostages or other civilians. Shoot targets into water, open containers or rubbish piles to hide the bodies before anyone sees them. Complete the mission without triggering an alarm.

achievements.description: Complete all The Pen and the Sword Challenges.
achievements.summary: Finish every challenge in The Pen and the Sword.

guide.context: Challenges can be completed across separate runs. Raise the score multiplier with these tasks before attempting the million-point score.

collectibles.name: Deadweight
collectibles.method: Shoot the crane control box open and move its container aside. Let Dragon Eye lock the hostages aboard. As Dragon Eye leaves the ship, shoot Spider Lily's office antenna and sound the ship horn several times, about five seconds apart. When the three main targets meet under crane position 11, lower the container onto them.

collectibles.name: Burning on the Dock of the Bay
collectibles.location: The explosive-filled container near the starting hostage position.
collectibles.method: Shoot the lock, then detonate the explosives when three marked targets are in the blast area.

collectibles.name: Death Raft
collectibles.method: When Dragon Eye meets Spider Lily below the suspended life raft, shoot the raft to crush both targets. If only one dies, cap the frame rate at 120 FPS or lower and replay the attempt.

collectibles.name: Landlubber
collectibles.method: Lure a target beneath the raised car with a ground shot, then shoot the lift control panel.

collectibles.name: Rock the Boat
collectibles.method: Trigger an alarm before killing any bodyguards, then kill every escaping bodyguard.

collectibles.name: Unlimited Power!
collectibles.location: Wet ground and electrical outlets around the docks.
collectibles.method: Shoot the left water barrel to make a puddle. Shoot outlets when guards stand in the water; use the puddle at the left dock and the outlet at the crossroads between the hostages, office and ship to reach three electrocutions.

collectibles.name: Don't Let the Boom Gate Hit You…
collectibles.method: Let Captain Re Thak flee toward the exit, then shoot the boom gate as she passes underneath.

collectibles.name: Kissing the Gunner's Daughter
collectibles.location: A container in the lowest row of the port.
collectibles.method: Open the container to reveal the cannon. Let a guard investigate, then fire the cannon as the guard turns away so the body falls into the nearby opening.

collectibles.name: Dead Men Tell No Tales
collectibles.location: Water, rubbish piles and open containers.
collectibles.method: Kill and conceal the three main targets. Shoot Jin Noo's nearby container open at the start and kill him as he investigates inside; shoot Dragon Eye toward water as he boards or leaves the ship. Lure Spider Lily beside a hiding place before shooting her.

collectibles.name: Skeleton Crew
collectibles.method: Conceal every bodyguard after killing them. Shoot garage loading-door buttons to open the doors, then knock bodies through before the doors close; reopen the doors if needed.

collectibles.name: Abandon Ship!
collectibles.method: Raise the alarm before killing a main target, then kill the three main targets during their escape. Stop Jin Noo before he kills the hostages and stop Dragon Eye before his boat gets away.

collectibles.name: Davy Jones's Locker
collectibles.method: Kill five marked targets by shooting them into the water.

collectibles.name: Skullcracker
collectibles.method: Kill every marked target with a headshot.

collectibles.name: Between the Devil…
collectibles.location: Jin Noo's office and the ship funnel.
collectibles.method: When Jin Noo enters his office, shoot the partly obscured horn speaker on the ship funnel to make him leave. Repeat the horn shot with a few seconds between shots if necessary.

collectibles.name: In the Spider's Web
collectibles.location: The hostage route to the ship.
collectibles.method: Kill Dragon Eye before the escort begins. Let Captain Re Thak take over and move the hostages to their container.

collectibles.name: Seagulls Sing Your Hearts Away
collectibles.method: Shoot five flying seagulls.

collectibles.name: No More Happy Hour
collectibles.location: The garage, beside the car lift.
collectibles.method: Shoot the beer bottle.

collectibles.name: Clean Bill of Health
collectibles.method: Kill the three main targets before Spider Lily can have the hostages moved.

collectibles.name: …And the Deep Blue Sea
collectibles.method: Shoot the office antenna while she is trying to make her phone call.

collectibles.name: Electric Feel
collectibles.method: Shoot six exposed electrical wires, including the wires in puddles.

collectibles.name: Ghost Ship
collectibles.method: Shoot its seven lights along the side and upper decks.

collectibles.name: From Here to Eternity
collectibles.method: Shoot its electrical box open and shoot the controls to move the suspended container.

collectibles.name: On the Waterfront
collectibles.method: Look beneath the next blue crane and shoot the lock on the hidden container.

collectibles.name: Quack on the Trigger
collectibles.method: Shoot every rubber duck. Use the [marked port map](https://www.reddit.com/user/godohandus/comments/bahp2x/sniper_assassin_hantu_port_featschallenges_updated/) to locate the small ducks.

collectibles.name: Codename Crane
collectibles.location: The numbered positions beneath the blue crane.
collectibles.method: Move the container above position 4 and lower it, then repeat at position 7. Use the crane's light to read the selected number.

collectibles.name: Self-Contained Research
collectibles.method: Shoot five container locks to open the doors.

collectibles.name: Rat O' Nine Tails
collectibles.method: Shoot every rat shown on the [marked port map](https://www.reddit.com/user/godohandus/comments/bahp2x/sniper_assassin_hantu_port_featschallenges_updated/).

achievements.summary: Finish Golden Handshake in New York.

steps.text: Play @mechanic{Golden Handshake} in @loc{New York}, complete the displayed mission objectives and use an exit.

achievements.summary: Raise New York location mastery to level 20.

steps.text: While connected online, complete unfinished challenges in @loc{New York} for mastery XP. Use the Challenges tab to choose new tasks, then finish a mission to apply the XP.

achievements.displayName: In a League of Their Own
achievements.description: Get a score above 1,000,000 points on Crime and Punishment.
achievements.summary: Finish Crime and Punishment with more than 1,000,000 points.

steps.text: Finish Siberia challenges to increase the score multiplier, then complete a Silent Assassin run. Hide bodies in snow, toilets or the rioting crowd, spare civilians and prevent guards from raising an alarm.

achievements.description: Complete Crime and Punishment as Silent Assassin.
achievements.summary: Earn Silent Assassin on Crime and Punishment.

guide.context: If the alarm starts or a civilian dies, restart the sniper mission and try again.

steps.text: In Siberia, eliminate Reznikov, Khabko and every marked Siberian Tiger without killing civilians. Conceal the bodies in snow piles, toilets or the rioting crowd before another guard finds them, and finish without an alarm.

achievements.description: Complete all Crime and Punishment Challenges.
achievements.summary: Finish every challenge in Crime and Punishment.

guide.context: An old HITMAN 2 carryover can leave all Siberia challenges completed without awarding this achievement. A fresh replay may not repair that imported state.

collectibles.name: Frothy Blanket
collectibles.method: Start a fire and wait for a guard to carry a fire extinguisher toward the fire. Shoot the extinguisher while the guard holds it.

collectibles.name: Collapse of the Union
collectibles.location: The main building beneath the Soviet star.
collectibles.method: Shoot the flag mechanism to release Khabko. Let him meet Reznikov, then drop the star as both targets step outside together.

collectibles.name: Shocking Violence
collectibles.method: Shoot the nearby faucet before Khabko beats the prisoner. Shoot the car battery when Khabko stands in the resulting water.

collectibles.name: Wish Upon a Star
collectibles.method: Shoot the Soviet star when a target stands beneath the star.

collectibles.name: This Is Fine
collectibles.method: Release Khabko by shooting the flag mechanism and shoot his two clothing sets to hurry his route. When he and Reznikov are inside the central building, shoot its base padlock to start the riot and let the building burn with both men inside.

collectibles.name: Foam Party
collectibles.location: The left side of the main building.
collectibles.method: Lure Reznikov beside a fire extinguisher and shoot the extinguisher to kill him.

collectibles.name: Pink Mist
collectibles.method: Kill every marked target with a headshot.

collectibles.name: Tiger Hunter
collectibles.method: Raise the alarm before killing the Siberian Tigers, then stop every Tiger from escaping.

collectibles.name: Shanked
collectibles.location: An icicle above a guard patrol.
collectibles.method: Wait for a target to pass underneath an icicle, then shoot the icicle. The far-left building has a suitable isolated spot.

collectibles.name: Electric Boogaloo
collectibles.method: Shoot the faucet before the prisoner beating, then shoot the battery while Khabko and his two guards stand in the puddle.

collectibles.name: Hold Your Fire
collectibles.method: Kill every target through accidents instead of shooting the targets. Use burning buildings, explosive barrels, extinguishers, icicles and electrified water.

collectibles.name: Hidden Tiger
collectibles.location: Snow piles, toilets and rioting crowds.
collectibles.method: Kill and conceal every Siberian Tiger. Shoot guards over railings into the crowd during a riot, or into snow piles and toilets.

collectibles.name: In the Cut
collectibles.location: The central building or snow piles.
collectibles.method: Hide both Khabko and Reznikov. Burning the central building with both men inside also hides their bodies.

collectibles.name: Lullaby of Birdland
collectibles.method: Shoot ten ducks: one on the far-left building's fuse box and one on its upper-right window shelf; one in the rubbish bin at Khabko's exercise yard; one on the desk in the main building's upper-left window, one in its rooftop window and one on the chair behind its front doors (shoot those doors open first); one beneath the desk visible through the gate building's right window and one on its chimney; one on the factory chimney with the red light; and one in the [lit barrel behind the prisoner](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/793115839885942301/68CAE7D95C96797400C1F3E03706B62131310B34/).

collectibles.name: Where Are My Pants?
collectibles.location: The far-left building and the main-gate building.
collectibles.method: Shoot Khabko's clothes on the ground-floor desk of the far-left building and his other clothes upstairs by the main gate.

collectibles.name: Snitches Get Stitches
collectibles.method: Shoot six rats: one on the kitchen-side barrel and one inside the kitchen when food is present and the cook is away. Shoot the fuel tanks in the left building's middle window to reveal the rat by the central padlock. Shoot the fuel tanks on the truck to reveal three more rats beneath the truck.

collectibles.name: Instigator
collectibles.method: Keep the main exit and the gate behind the administration building closed. Open the other internal gates, then shoot the central tower padlock to start the riot. Let the prisoners reach and burn the left building. Only then open the gate behind the administration building so the riot can spread through the remaining sections.

collectibles.name: Porcelain King
collectibles.method: Shoot three targets into toilets. Two toilets are above and below Khabko's barrack; the third is in the lower-right corner. Shoot Khabko's food poison to send him to a toilet, or use nearby ground shots to lure guards into position.

collectibles.name: Fusil for Everyone
collectibles.method: Start the riot, then shoot a Siberian Tiger over the railing into the crowd.

collectibles.name: Cold War
collectibles.location: The snow piles around the perimeter.
collectibles.method: Shoot five targets into snow piles. Use ground shots to bring guards near a pile and shockwave rounds to push a fallen body farther if necessary.

collectibles.name: Burning Down the House
collectibles.method: Open internal gates but keep the main exit shut. Shoot the lowest building's explosives and the flammables upstairs in the far-left building. Start the riot at the central padlock and let prisoners carry the fires through the opened sections, including the main building.

collectibles.name: The Great Escape
collectibles.location: The lowest main gate, beneath two pairs of water tanks.
collectibles.method: Open the internal gates and start a riot. Use Instinct to find the yellow control panel inside the building beside the main gate; shoot the panel through the doorway to open the final exit.

collectibles.name: Black Site
collectibles.method: Shoot ten lamps. Avoid standing guards below the lamps unless you want an accident kill.

collectibles.name: A Feat for Crows
collectibles.method: Shoot eight crows: the left radio tower; the lamp between the toilet and kitchen; the central tower with the blue light; the first silo right of the main building; the painted chimney; the large electricity pylon; the gate building antenna; and the main-gate sign.

collectibles.name: Prison Food
collectibles.method: Shoot the emetic poison beside the cook's food and let Khabko eat. Poisoning the wine in the main building does not complete this food challenge.

collectibles.name: False Flag
collectibles.location: The flagpole on the main building.
collectibles.method: Shoot the mechanism at the base of the flag to lower the flag and release Khabko.

collectibles.name: Na Zdorovje
collectibles.method: Shoot the five bottles: beside the burning barrel in Khabko's yard; in the left window of the central guard tower below the main building; in the warden's upper-right office window; in the painted building's upper-right window; and on the [outdoor table shown here](https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/793115839885943081/982467F73D899E6F60FB8D40E6A40B9D1632C23A/).
